extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors and users attempting to create a new article (e.g., about 'YouTube humor')
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating or troubleshooting a new Wikipedia article title (here shown for 'YouTube humor'), including account permissions, searching for existing coverage, redirects, and deletion recovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are not able or permitted to create the article directly, submit a draft via the article wizard or request that a new article be created.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article wizard can be used to submit a draft for review; there is also an option to request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'YouTube humor' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify whether the topic already exists under another title or spelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can reveal existing coverage or appropriate target pages for redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an alternate capitalization or spelling better matches existing pages, create or request a redirect rather than a duplicate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay / purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to refresh and see recently created pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted page troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?' for reasons and next steps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion log to understand why a page was removed and whether it can be recreated or recovered.
